dct_description_sm: Description based on data extracted from World Digital Library, which may be extracted from partner institutions.
Original resource at: National Library of Brazil.

This map, showing the southwestern part of the Iberian Peninsula, was published in Amsterdam by François Halma (1653-1722), a Dutch bookseller and publisher who started a business in Utrecht, later moved to Amsterdam, and finally settled in Leeuwarden. In addition to publishing maps, Halma produced one of the earliest Dutch-French dictionaries.
Title devised, in English, by Library staff.
dct_title_s: New Map Showing the Spanish and Portuguese Explorations with Observations of the Most Ingenious Geographers of Spain and Portugal.
